description.html: HabiStat Crested Gecko Diet Mango 80g is a larger pack of the popular complete mango-flavored food for crested geckos (Correlophus ciliatus). This 80g jar is the ideal choice for owners with several geckos or anyone who wants a more economical option than the smaller 50g pack. The food comes in a practical jar for easy storage and portioning, and the airtight seal keeps the product fresh for a long time.

The formula is identical to the smaller pack - it contains over 50% real fruit (mango powder) and 9 different animal protein sources. The nutritional values are excellent: 23% protein, 1.95% calcium and a calcium-to-phosphorus ratio of 3.87:1, an optimal balance for preventing metabolic bone disease. The food has no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives and is completely natural and safe for everyday use in geckos of all ages.

Preparation is very simple: take about 5g of powder from the jar and mix it with water until you get a ketchup-like consistency. Put the prepared mash in a shallow dish and place it in the terrarium, preferably in the evening when geckos are most active. Serve the food 1 to 2 times a week and remove leftovers after 24 hours. An 80g jar is enough for roughly 16 meals for one gecko, which makes it a very cost-effective option.
